items.mainDefect: Supplying both a nonempty totpCode and a valid backupCode bypasses password verification.

secondary.defect: The same credential combination also bypasses the SSO checks.

items.mainDefect: Dismissing the backup-code screen with Escape or an outside click skips onEnable, leaving the parent UI showing 2FA as disabled.

secondary.defect: Dismissal also leaves the modal step, password, and backup codes in state, so reopening displays the stale backup-code screen.

items.mainDefect: Backup codes are compared with an early-exiting comparison that can leak information through timing.

secondary.defect: Backup-code input is not lowercased, causing uppercase input to fail against the stored lowercase hex codes.

items.mainDefect: The assertion checks the truthiness of the Promise returned by isChecked(), so it cannot fail.

secondary.defect: The test never closes the backup-code screen before checking the switch, so onEnable has not run to update its state.

items.mainDefect: The copy test only checks a success toast and does not verify the clipboard contents.

secondary.defect: The modal shows a success toast without awaiting clipboard.writeText, so the toast does not establish that copying succeeded.
The download test checks only the filename and does not validate the downloaded backup codes.
